notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Tweaked A.I. system. 
Added Streaming level sections for bette performance.
Fix various bugs.

notes.title: Shortcut Fix
notes.notes: Apparently the shortcut to the executable was not working from the Steam application. Should be fixed.

notes.title: Minor tweaks to AI
notes.notes: After some feedback, I decided to make the AI a bit slower.

notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.notes: Fixed typos and a glitch in Chapter 4.

notes.title: Checkpoints!
notes.notes: THere are now checkpoints in certain chapters so you don't need to start over if you die. The checkpoints are automatic and will also be reset if you load a chapter from the main menu.

notes.title: Major Seventh Angel update!
notes.notes:
[b]The Whole Story[/b]
I'm proud to announce that all chapters are finished! The complete Seventh Angel storyline has been integrated into this release. I will keep Seventh Angel in [u]Early Access[/u] as I would like to continue to enhance the experience while addressing bugs as they are discovered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41352626/6ab564f75a975965f89890e94dbc9f5da5879205.jpg[/img]


[b]I See The Light[/b]
As per some recomendations, the lighting system has been revamped for visual sharpness while still retaining the foreboding sense of unease. Exposure settings are now user controlable in the settings menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41352626/c9673164dec4d1bfffe0c81e0afc1ae476f64ebb.jpg[/img]

[b]Metahumans Take Center Stage[/b]
I finally figured out how to integrate and animate Metahumans with control rigs and Live Link. This has really brought the key characters of the storyline to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41352626/2932adc0bd549b80f87651f01200f8ec073de934.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41352626/53961c73bf754ca53443c3f30c5da2a5b18114aa.jpg[/img]


Enjoy and please send feedback!


[b]Change highlights:[/b]
[list]
[*] All Chapters completed and included in Early Access
[*] 12 total Chapters
[*] Reworked AI
[*] Rebuilt lighting throughout
[*] Dungeon level completely redesigned
[*] Metahumans integration
[*] Menu Game Pause
[*] Subtitles throughout
[*] Hint System fixes
[*] Additional animations
[*] Additional Music
[/list]

notes.title: Major Goof!
notes.notes:
Hello!

So I goofed with assigning builds in [b]STEAM [/b]and many of you that had [u]purchased [/u]the game were still only getting the DEMO version.  I have [b]corrected [/b]the mistake and this update will be the full game for those of you who support my game.

So sorry for the bungle but I'm still learning how STEAM organizes stuff behind the scenes (tricky stuff).

Thank you all for your support and please continue to send me feedback/suggestions. I truly want to have the community involved in the development of my game.

Thanks,
rich!

notes.title: HINTS
notes.notes:
I've added a [b]HINT [/b]system to the game. When turned on, it will create a faint glow around key items and areas that the player needs to take or goto for advancement within the level. 

In the screenshot here you can see a yellow key in the distance. This is an example of how the HINT system will help players that are stuck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41352626/f512d24fe70e582b53055d583ffd76cbd9028e62.jpg[/img]


The HINT setting is OFF by DEFAULT. It's available in the [b]SETTINGS [/b]menu.
You will have to restart (reload) the level before it activates. Still working on making that seamless.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41352626/e41886f59df844b7ab4e05d48e825abb22f317e3.jpg[/img]

Let me know what you think!

-rich
